mapper.sql: p.place_id AS placeId, p.place_name AS placeName, p.add1 AS add1, p.add2 AS add2, p.tel AS tel, p.content_type_id AS contentTypeId, p.map_x AS mapX, p.map_y AS mapY, p.first_image AS firstImage, p.radius_meters AS radiusMeters, p.is_active AS isActive, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.deleted_at AS deletedAt, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.member_id) FROM visit v JOIN place vp ON vp.place_id = v.place_id WHERE vp.place_group_id = p.place_group_id) AS visitCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place_quiz_info pqi JOIN place qp ON qp.place_id = pqi.place_id WHERE qp.place_group_id = p.place_group_id AND pqi.is_active = TRUE) AS quizSetCnt
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM place p
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.place_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO place (place_name, add1, add2, tel, content_type_id, map_x, map_y, first_image, lcls_systm1, lcls_systm2, lcls_systm3, radius_meters, created_at, updated_at, is_active) VALUES (#{req.placeName}, #{req.add1}, #{req.add2OrEmpty}, #{req.telOrEmpty}, #{req.contentTypeIdOrDefault}, #{req.mapXOrZero}, #{req.mapYOrZero}, #{req.firstImageOrEmpty}, '', '', '', #{req.radiusMetersOrDefault}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt}, TRUE)
mapper.select:
SELECT p.place_id AS placeId, p.place_name AS placeName, NULL AS category, p.is_active AS isActive, p.language AS language FROM place p
ORDER BY p.place_id ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT rep.place_id AS placeId, rep.place_name AS placeName, NULL AS category, rep.is_active AS isActive, p.language AS language FROM place p JOIN place rep ON rep.place_id = p.place_group_id WHERE p.place_id = #{placeId}

SELECT pc.place_content_id AS placeContentId, pc.difficulty AS difficulty, pc.language AS language, pc.description AS description, sp.place_group_id AS placeId FROM place_content pc JOIN place sp ON sp.place_id = pc.place_id WHERE pc.place_content_id = #{placeContentId}
mapper.sql: COALESCE( (SELECT s.place_id FROM place s WHERE s.place_group_id = (SELECT place_group_id FROM place WHERE place_id = #{placeId}) AND s.language = #{language} LIMIT 1), (SELECT place_group_id FROM place WHERE place_id = #{placeId}) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO place_content (description, language, difficulty, place_id) SELECT #{description}, #{language}, #{difficulty},
mapper.update: UPDATE place SET is_active = FALSE, deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, updated_at = #{deletedAt} WHERE place_group_id = (SELECT place_group_id FROM (SELECT place_group_id FROM place WHERE place_id = #{placeId}) t) AND is_active = TRUE

UPDATE place SET is_active = TRUE, deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE place_group_id = (SELECT place_group_id FROM (SELECT place_group_id FROM place WHERE place_id = #{placeId}) t) AND is_active = FALSE
